title: Reading a conditional trigger removal
description: You can identify the object named by a DROP statement.

steps.description: DROP TRIGGER identifies a trigger as the object to remove. You name update_ytd_sales as the target.
IF EXISTS makes this cleanup conditional on the trigger being present. The statement contains no table-removal command.

steps.question: Does this statement query and display the trigger's rows?
steps.answer: No. It removes the named trigger if present rather than returning a result set.

steps.description: The supplied trace visits the DROP statement and shows no text output. You have no reported row data from this cleanup operation.
